registration.purpose: Eligible single-carrier set comparisons; same allies and enemies in every paired context. Diagnostic only.
registration.baseline: Original common04 runtime plus verified missing-recipient guard; no anchored pacing or kit/policy trial combined.
registration.selection: All eight named carriers face all eight frozen scenes with every set; primary/contrast scenes declared from mechanics before sampling.
registration.normalization: Only carrier HP/attack/defense scale to its own role-kit total for matched-utility. Fixed-core holds these three stats to its role-kit values; it is not matched utility. Allies are exact in both arms.
limitations: No production change or acceptance replacement. Original 35–75% gate remains visible.
Different carriers/crews have different difficulty. Do not interpret cross-context means as calibrated acceptance.
Secondary fixed-core arm distinguishes utility normalization but changes total displayed power; report separately.
Enemy cleanse is absent from the common catalog fixture; Emberfelt contrast5 is rear healing/reflection, not a verified cleanse weakness.
Static skill eligibility is necessary but not proof that auto uses it. Record actions, Scald and explicit gear events.
